contracts.action: Active-workspace settings broadcast now runs in afterCommit (after the gate commits) instead of inside runSwitch's persistActive (before commit)
contracts.equivalent_path: Previously notifyOverridesChanged ran inside persistActive, after reg.setActive and workspaceSettings.refresh(target) but before gate.commit and before dropPendingCaptures. The sibling call site at index.ts:130 passes it as the WorkspaceSettings `changed` callback.
contracts.before_after: Before: listeners and windows received the new workspace's effective settings while the gate was still closed and the switch was not certain. A failure after that point could not happen inside persistActive, but a throw in a later step of persistActive would have left windows with the new settings while the old workspace was reopened. After: persistActive only sets active and refreshes the cache; switch-transaction.ts:72-80 then drops pending captures, commits the gate and calls afterCommit, so the notify, title refresh, workspaces:changed and library:changed all follow a certain commit. notifyOverridesChanged recomputes from the overrides source, which reads reg.active() (index.ts:123), already set before the commit; it returns early if nothing changed (settings-store.ts:235).
contracts.visible_effect: Windows and main listeners get the new effective settings (settings:changed) once the switch commits. A failed or cancelled switch no longer broadcasts the target's settings. relocateActive (switch-transaction.ts:136) shares these deps, so a folder relocation now also runs a recompute; it is a no-op when the effective settings are unchanged.
contracts.failure_mode: If persistActive throws (e.g. reg.setActive or the refresh), the transaction reopens the gate and aborts windows (switch-transaction.ts:73-77) and no settings are broadcast, which is the intended behaviour. Note that reg.setActive may already have switched the active id before a refresh failure, and the effective cache is then not recomputed until the next notify; this is unchanged by this diff.

structuredOutput.summary: I found nothing to flag in either file. The code change moves `notifyOverridesChanged()` out of `persistActive` and into `afterCommit` (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/index.ts:406`). A failed or cancelled switch therefore no longer broadcasts the target workspace's settings. The overrides source reads `reg.active()`, which `persistActive` has already set before the commit, so the recompute sees the right workspace. Folder relocation shares these deps and now also runs the recompute, which does nothing when the effective settings are unchanged. In the spec, the three `settings:*` rows now sit inside the channel table instead of above its header. None of the open threads from earlier rounds are on these two files, so there are no thread replies.
